This is a classic he-said-she-said, but Alice, your own defense actually makes you look worse. You just admitted that Bob left Electrical *before* you did, which means you were the last person to be alone with Charlie. You had the perfect opportunity to kill him right after Bob walked out, before you headed down to Security. 

Bob's timeline also checks out with Eve seeing him in Upper Engine at tick 16. If Bob killed Charlie at tick 10, he would have had to immediately flee to Upper Engine, which is possible, but you being alone with Charlie is a smoking gun. Furthermore, Bob's theory about Diana dying in Weapons makes a lot of sense, considering you were the last one to see her there. 

Eve is voting Alice, Alice is voting Bob. I'm the deciding vote here, and based on the fact that Alice was definitively the last person with the victim, my vote is going to Alice.
